title: Step 64-A canonical handoff, live guard and Customer Account/After-Sales scope freeze
description: Documentation/governance-only Stage A for Step 64. Verify terminal Step 63 handoff on live main, record the Owner Graph deferral without claiming Graph PASS, freeze Customer Account & After-Sales scope, prove current Storefront placeholder state and high-level backend readiness, register the A-I execution plan and keep runtime/API/database/dependency mutation forbidden until Stage A completes canonical transport.

dependencies.name: Cart & Checkout Frontend final canonical closure
dependencies.evidence: PR #315 merged; post-merge Canonical CI #1351 and Phase A #850 passed; terminal Lock release comment 5980921349; HOS-67 Done. Graph is explicitly deferred by Project Owner and is not represented as PASS.

evidence.graph_state: DEFERRED_BY_OWNER / LOCAL_ONLY_UNAVAILABLE; no Graph PASS claim is permitted; future reconciliation remains required.

discovery.storefront_routes: /account, /account/profile, /account/addresses, /account/orders, /account/orders/:order-number, /account/tools, /account/returns/:return-number? and /account/warranty/:claim-number? are registered and remain RoutePlaceholder surfaces targeted to Step 64.
discovery.identity_profile: Canonical runtime exposes OTP/session/logout boundaries plus customer profile read/update.
discovery.addresses: Canonical runtime exposes customer-owned list/create/update/delete/set-default; Step 63 already hardened ownership, idempotency and geography usage.
discovery.wishlist: Canonical runtime and Step-62 Storefront foundation already provide authoritative list/add/remove; account management was intentionally deferred to Step 64.
discovery.orders: Canonical runtime exposes customer order list/detail/timeline/invoice and idempotent cancel.
discovery.returns: Canonical runtime exposes customer return create/list/detail/timeline/cancel.
discovery.warranty: Canonical runtime exposes customer warranty create/list/detail/timeline.
discovery.notifications_tools: Owner-scoped in-app notification infrastructure exists, while historical design also references loyalty/product-alert/review capabilities. Stage 64-B must prove present OpenAPI/runtime authority before any such UI is implemented.
discovery.wholesale_boundary: Wholesale application/status/pricing remains Step 65 and is excluded from Step 64.
discovery.migration_need: No Stage-A evidence requires a database migration.
discovery.dependency_need: No Stage-A evidence requires a new dependency.

stages.goal: Canonical handoff, live guard, discovery and Account/After-Sales scope freeze
Backend/OpenAPI contract readiness for Account, Orders, customer tools, Returns, Warranty and Notifications
Shared Storefront Account session/data/recovery foundation and Account overview shell
Profile, account security and customer-owned Address management
Orders, order detail, timeline, invoice and authoritative customer actions
Wishlist, notifications and only contract-authorized customer tools
RTL, accessibility, responsive/state hardening and integrated browser acceptance
Final canonical verification, documentation reconciliation and Step 65 handoff

acceptance_criteria.description: Live main, Step 63 terminal merge/postmerge/Lock/Linear state, Roadmap, open PRs and competing Step-64 writer state are inspected before Stage-A write.
Step 64 A-I plan and exact Customer Account/After-Sales IN boundary are frozen; Wholesale remains Step 65, Content Step 66 and Admin Steps 67+.
All eight Step-64 Storefront routes are proven existing placeholders rather than hidden implementation.
High-level current runtime readiness for identity/profile, addresses, Wishlist, orders/invoices, returns and warranty is recorded without inventing missing notification/customer-tool contracts.
Current runtime/OpenAPI/generated contracts override legacy wireframe endpoint labels; design remains authority only for UX intent and inherited states.
Graph/Graphify is recorded as DEFERRED_BY_OWNER / LOCAL_ONLY_UNAVAILABLE and never represented as PASS.
Stage 64-A changes only its documentation/governance allowlist and introduces no runtime/API/OpenAPI/DB/dependency/permission/business-rule mutation.

Canonical completion of 64-A requires exact-head verification, artifact-bound REVIEW/LOCK evidence, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before 64-B runtime/API mutation.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 64-A is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write and ungoverned runtime mutation are prohibited. Step 64-B runtime/API mutation is forbidden until 64-A canonical transport and terminal Lock release are complete.
